description: Add unit tests for _handle_query_supervisor phases (content filter, semantic cache, agent invocation, streaming, scoring), handle_voice edge cases, handle_feedback, and handle_hitl_callback. These are the most complex methods in PropertyBot.
steps: Create tests/unit/test_bot_query_supervisor.py following the established pattern

Add TestQuerySupervisorContentFilter class: (a) injection detected in hard mode sends blocked response and returns; (b) injection detected in soft/log mode logs but continues to agent; (c) content_filter_enabled=False skips guard entirely

Add TestQuerySupervisorSemanticCache class: (a) cache HIT for cacheable query type returns cached response without invoking agent; (b) cache MISS proceeds to agent invocation; (c) non-cacheable query type (CHITCHAT, OFF_TOPIC) skips cache entirely; (d) contextual query skips cache check; (e) filter-sensitive query with no signature skips cache

Add TestQuerySupervisorHandoffMode class: (a) handoff mode='human' relays message and returns without RAG; (b) handoff mode='human_waiting' relays message AND continues with RAG; (c) no handoff proceeds normally

Add TestHandleFeedback class in tests/unit/test_bot_feedback_integration.py: (a) FeedbackCB 'done' action answers and returns; (b) FeedbackCB 'dislike' action shows reason keyboard; (c) FeedbackCB 'like' action writes score to Langfuse; (d) legacy 'fb:done' data answers and returns; (e) legacy 'fb:1:traceid' writes positive score; (f) legacy 'fb:0:traceid' without reason shows reason keyboard

Add TestHandleHitlCallback class: (a) 'hitl:approve' answers 'Accepted', removes keyboard, rebuilds agent and invokes; (b) 'hitl:cancel' answers 'Cancelled', removes keyboard; (c) missing from_user or message gracefully answers callback
Add TestSendMarkdownChunks testing _send_markdown_chunks: delegates to send_html_messages from telegram_formatting module
acceptance_criteria: New test files tests/unit/test_bot_query_supervisor.py and tests/unit/test_bot_feedback_integration.py exist
All new tests pass: uv run pytest tests/unit/test_bot_query_supervisor.py tests/unit/test_bot_feedback_integration.py -q --timeout=30
Content filter tests exercise the guard logic with both hard and soft modes
Cache tests verify the semantic cache hit/miss branching with appropriate mocking of _cache.check_semantic
Tests are isolated with mocked LLM, cache, embeddings, and Langfuse
verification: uv run pytest tests/unit/test_bot_query_supervisor.py tests/unit/test_bot_feedback_integration.py tests/unit/test_bot_handlers.py tests/unit/test_bot_handlers_query.py -q --timeout=30
